purpose: One place that states what is done, what is open, in what order, and why. Exists because work spread across a specification, three contracts and two audit documents, and the sequence had to be re-derived from measurement at each step. Every entry below is either proven on the builder or measured against the tree; nothing here is a recollection.

baseline_for_attribution.note: the parent of the vocabulary tranche. Twelve tests fail there, unrelated to the network. A slice is green when it introduces no failure name absent from this set.

done_and_proven.scope: I/O moved into cynic-network/src/adapters/; FCIS enforced by four executable architecture tests
LocalNetworkAdapter extracted from cynic-host into cynic-network/adapters/host_probe.rs
duplicated mesh registry models and the double JSON conversion removed
canonical plane vocabulary in code; legacy aliases confined to the deserialization boundary
plane accessors; no parsed-and-dropped fields; service/reservation divergence is an explicit error
four registries rewritten in canonical vocabulary; mesh CIDR corrected to 100.64.0.0/10
nine registry readers migrated onto the shared plane resolver
done_and_proven.proof: cynic-network 60/60; five tests failing at baseline now pass

done_and_proven.scope: mesh_plan reconciled with the canonical resolver; the empty-plan and dropped-node defects fixed

sequencing_rationale: Three measured dependencies decide the order. First INF9: a detector with no invocation site is a document, so every enforcement claim in the contracts is currently prose, and making one detector real is worth more than adding a tenth normative rule. Second INF7 then INF8: network actuation performs no read-back and the domain has no expected-state type, so a mutation can leave a partial state nothing detects and drift cannot be computed where it is owned; both are the network breaching the coherence pattern in AGENTS.md, which requires read-back proof. Third the DAG inversion is large but inert: 86 files invert it and none prevents a build, so it is repaired after the correctness defects. What is deliberately not sequenced is T9 through T12, the SOCKS5h, subnet router, MSS clamping and dual-stack work: they are new capability with no executor, and building them before the system can observe itself would produce more surface that cannot be verified.
critical_path_rationale: O1 makes a rule enforceable and finds real faults. O3 gives the domain an expected state. O2 then has something to prove a mutation against.

open_work.title: Make INF1 real: wire cynic-node registry-observation to the hypervisor
open_work.why_first: the only item that makes a normative rule enforceable, and it would immediately surface organ-headscale, a mesh coordinator running at 10.10.10.40 under a name that resolves nowhere
open_work.scope: extend the existing registry-observation surface to read the container inventory from the hypervisor and to resolve every declared node name; emit a schema'd report carrying orphan declarations and unregistered members
open_work.blocks: every other enforcement claim in both contracts
open_work.risk: reading the hypervisor needs credentials; the registry already carries a credential_ref and lease metadata for the Proxmox token, so this reads an existing authority rather than adding one

open_work.title: Introduce an expected-state type in cynic-network
open_work.why: grep for desired_state, expected_state and target_state in the crate returns zero. RFC-NET-001 §1.1 principle 3 and §4 both presuppose a comparison between expected and observed, and the domain that owns the telemetry cannot perform it. drift_detected is a literal set by a caller.
open_work.scope: an expected-state model so observed minus expected is computable and the domain emits drift rather than having it supplied
open_work.unblocks: O2, and the RFC's own §1.1 principle 3

open_work.title: Give network actuation a read-back proof
open_work.why: network_actuator/execution.rs contains zero occurrences of verify, read_back, observe or prove, while read_back has 1094 references elsewhere. The DNS bundle performs four independent fs::write calls, so a failure on the third leaves a partial state nothing detects.
open_work.scope: after every actuation, observe the state the action claimed to produce; a partial write is an observed state, never a silent success

open_work.title: Fix the two imperative network I/O sites and collapse the duplicated WireGuard read-back
open_work.why: watchdog.rs spawns ping directly instead of reading L2/L3 state through the host probe it already depends on; the CLI audit shells out to wg. Two crates own WireGuard read-back: cynic-host parses dump, cynic-node parses latest-handshakes.
open_work.scope: route both through cynic-network adapters and give WireGuard read-back a single owner
open_work.risk: low, two sites, no behaviour change intended

open_work.title: Repair the 86-file DAG inversion
open_work.why: cynic-host is L1 and depends on six higher crates across 82 files; cynic-lifecycle 3; cynic-discovery-host 1. RFC-NET-001 §7 previously named a single file, which measurement corrected.
open_work.scope: dependency inversion per target crate, starting with cynic-node-protocol because peer_resolver_mesh and local_autonomy_runtime sit on it
open_work.risk: large; must be sliced per target crate, never as one tranche. cynic-discovery-host re-exports from the cynic-host monolith, which is both this violation and an N6 single-owner violation.

open_work.title: Declare the ratchet debt
open_work.why: cynic-host is 86641 LOC and cynic-node 55492 against a 25k hard boundary in foundation.json, with no layer_debt record for either. The boundary is being violated silently.
open_work.scope: either declare the debt with a dated plan or split below the ceiling; the choice is governance

open_work.title: Resolve the DNS cutover, which is infrastructure rather than code
open_work.why: service.cynic resolves nowhere, so the six reservations the repository declares name a zone with no published record. synapse.cynic is not a published zone either: dnsmasq answers it with TTL 0 and serves no SOA and no NS, which is a hosts-file emulation. The registry the node loads is entirely legacy, with mesh CIDR 10.20.0.0/24, an RFC 1918 range RFC-NET-001 §6.2 forbids for the overlay.
sequence: publish service.cynic alongside the existing answers
project registry records into it and prove the projection by query
remove static per-host entries one at a time, each proven resolved before the next
retire synapse.cynic once nothing resolves it
reconcile the runtime registry to canonical vocabulary last
open_work.blocked_on: operator admission for resolver deployment and for mutating /etc/cynic/registry.json, which is root-owned
open_work.rollback: each step rolls back by ceasing to project; the legacy zone stays served until the last step

open_work.title: Reconcile the two remaining naming defects
open_work.why: cynic-lxc-headscale does not resolve and is absent from the runtime registry, while its address belongs to organ-headscale, which runs headscale on port 8080 under a name appearing in no registry and no hosts file. cynic-node/src/usecases/network_surfaces_uc.rs:564 looks the coordinator up under the wrong name, so its default endpoint cannot reach a live process. local-builder declares no address while 10.10.10.119 is the running builder.
open_work.scope: rename the declaration to organ-headscale, remove local-builder, correct the lookup; add organ-forgejo and cynic-agent-host which run but are declared nowhere
open_work.depends_on: O1, so the detector catches the correction if it is wrong

verification_discipline: prove on the builder, never on cortex; cortex ICEs on rustc 1.96 and its RAM is unstable
compare against the baseline failure set every time; a slice is green when it adds no new failure name
never rsync into the canonical checkout: commit, push, then merge --ff-only on the builder

restore Cargo.lock after every builder run; cargo rewrites it without --locked, and --locked is currently unusable because the committed lockfile does not match the package dependency sets, which is pre-existing debt proven at edbf8fae
format only explicit files; never bare cargo fmt in a shared worktree
when a claim is a count, re-verify it with the command the document carries before committing; three counts in these documents were wrong when taken by hand
